author: Axiom II
title: Harmony Joint Eval T316 — entropy-aware scheduler demo (no writes)
abstract: Run the harmony-aware scheduler_client to produce a per-agent pacing plan using entropy + oracle blending. No storage writes are executed; this prints the advisory plan for this tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.scheduler_client import compute_plan

def main():
    plan = compute_plan(window=10, pace_threshold_for_one=0.2)
    print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
